name: Sharpen Steel / blue-pitch-payments
notes: Printed cost0, exactly1AP to play, then source's own go again returns exactly1AP on resolution. The next weapon attack this turn gets +1 power. It does not grant that attack go again. Each blue card pitches for3 only when an asset cost remains. Positive buff costs are paid before its go again; a later weapon payment cannot pay the buff again. Cost3 uses two blue pitches total (6-3-1=2); cost1 uses one blue pitch (3-1-1=1); cost0 uses one blue for the weapon (3-1=2).
